_readme: The WilsonWorks agents anyone can install, with: node agents/bin/install-agent.js <key>. node agents/bin/agent.js catalog lists them and says which are installed. The installer (install.js) offers the first one that has an offer line, and installs any of them without asking with --agent <key>. Each source is the agent's package: a git address, a folder or a .zip file. agents/lib/catalog.js reads this file; WW_AGENT_CATALOG points at another one (for tests and drills), where a relative source is read from that file's own folder.

agents.name: Louise
agents.title: The Research Librarian
agents.line: Researches your questions with a source for every fact, and keeps what she finds on shelves you can browse.
agents.offer: Louise, the research librarian, can move into your office now. Install her?

agents.name: Bryn
agents.title: The Trail Guide
agents.line: Helps you think a decision through. Five scouts weigh it on their own, she looks for where the plan could fail, and she keeps your call so you never argue it twice.
